criteria.silhouette_scale: Selected refinement keeps wheel, compact crankcase and horizontal flanged barrel; low feet replace copper plate. Proportion targets are explicit in the brief.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Faceted castings and flanges translate to cuboids and 45-degree bevel strips; rivets belong in panel UVs.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Use perpendicular X shaft and Z cylinder in native model; generated perspective is not an orthographic mechanical drawing. Short feet stay outside wheel sweep.
criteria.period_materials: Iron/steel with restrained brass cups/collars; no large copper panel.
criteria.family_consistency: Retains selected engine and refinery palette, original casing bed.
criteria.controls_readability: Small front-center dial/lever panel and accessible side ports.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Only rear copper construction slab removed; fuel/work/crafting remain unchanged.
